purpose: Blame one circumstance for an unfortunate consequence.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause / Nである / な-adjectiveな + ばかりに
Because I got the address wrong, the parcel never arrived.
Because I chose it solely for its price, it broke straight away.
One unnecessary remark made my friend angry.
formation: Plain clause / Nである / な-adjectiveな + ばかりに
restrictions: Carries regret or a sense that this cause was decisive.
mistake: Use ので for a neutral reason without blame.
